title: Print a whole number
test_suite:
import io, sys

def test_prints_42():
    captured = io.StringIO()
    sys.stdout = captured
    exec(open("exercise.py").read())
    sys.stdout = sys.__stdout__
    output = captured.getvalue()
    assert output == '42\n', f"Expected 42, got {output!r}"

title: Print your age as a number
instruction: Print your age as a number (no quotes).
test_suite:
import io, sys, re

def test_prints_age_number():
    captured = io.StringIO()
    sys.stdout = captured
    exec(open("exercise.py").read())
    sys.stdout = sys.__stdout__
    output = captured.getvalue()
    assert re.match('\\d+\n', output), f"Output should be a number, got {output!r}"
